thread:
jordan: Handoff notes for tonight — quick summary.
- Current cluster avg GPU util ~72%. pool-east-1 is highest at ~88% (sustained for last 20m).
- Two items to watch: AcmeCorp nightly batch (job id 5678) scheduled 23:30 UTC, and rwd-model-v2 canary rollout at 01:00 UTC which may cause KV cache flushes and short traffic spikes.
- Burst policy: pool-east-1 burstLimit = 250 concurrent streams, soft throttle at 85%.
- If pool hits burstLimit, prefer temporary tenant throttles vs. model rollback. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-burst

Commands I used to check stats earlier:
```
infractl pool-stats --pool pool-east-1 --interval 5m
infractl list-jobs --tenant AcmeCorp --since 2h
```

I'll be reachable on pager until 02:30 UTC. please ping if you take a swap.

sam: :eyes: Taking coverage 22:45–02:30 UTC. I'll watch pool-east-1 and the Acme job. If we cross 250 streams I'll try soft-evict non-prod tenants first.

maria: Noted. I already bumped AcmeCorp soft quota by +10% for tonight (ticket #2345) to reduce sudden throttle. Will revert if we see instability.

kevin: If burstLimit is hit and eviction doesn't recover within 3 min, do this quick throttle command to shed best-effort tenants:
```
infractl throttle-tenants --pool pool-east-1 --label best-effort --rate 0.3
```
Also watch token-error rate; if token errors > 1% roll back the canary immediately.

olivia: FYI logs earlier showed Redis 503 spikes during last cache flush; keep an eye on redis-latency > 200ms alerts. I put a short note on the canary plan: reduce canary qps to 10% if redis latency increases.

deploy-bot: Canary for rwd-model-v2 scheduled: 2026-03-18T01:00:00Z (canary 5% traffic)

sam: ack. I'll escalate to @kevin if we see repeated burstLimit hits or queue growth > 500.

jordan: Thanks — if anyone swaps in, drop a short note here with ETA. Also, if you see repeated 429s with origin=quota please paste the sample log line.

kevin: Quick note on rollbacks: prefer config rollback (traffic -> previous model) over full cluster scale-down unless GPUs are saturated and queue latency > 3s.

maria: Oncall swap window available 00:30–03:00 UTC if someone needs to swap earlier.

sam: :thumbsup: will post a short status at 00:00 and 01:15 UTC.

jordan: leaving handoff. Good luck everyone and ping on #pager if anything noisy.
